content.value: Consider a toroidal coil with a ferrite core. Suppose that the coil has 200 turns and is used in HF work will small signals. The mean diameter of the toroid is 2.5 cm and the core diameter is 0.5 cm. if the core is MnZn ferrite, what is the approximate inductance of coil? Noted that the $\mu _ { \uparrow }$ of MnZn ferrite is equal to $2 \times 1 0 ^ { 3 }$
